projections.title: DEMO TEAM MULTIMEDIA PROFESSIONAL – CONTRACTOR SUPPORT FOR SMC DIRECTORATE
projections.description: NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C LABOR CATEGORY 56: DEMO TEAM MULTIMEDIA PROFESSIONAL – CONTRACTOR SUPPORT FOR SMC DIRECTORATE Location: Brussels, Belgium – On-site Number of Candidates: One Candidate Period of Performance: Base Period: Contract Award – 31 December 2026 Option Period 1: 1 January 2027 – 31 December 2027 Option Period 2: 1 January 2028 – 31 December 2028 Option Period 3: 1 January 2029 – 31 December 2029 Taskings: 1. Event coverage and field production: Plan, coordinate, and execute photographic, video, and audio coverage of ACT-promoted conferences, exercises, demonstrations, workshops, senior leader engagements, official visits, interviews, and other events in both controlled and dynamic environments. 2. Multimedia content creation: Produce professional-quality still photography, video, audio, interviews, event highlight videos, reels, short-form vertical videos, promotional products, and multimedia packages tailored for ACT digital communication channels and campaign requirements. 3. Rapid-turnaround production: Deliver same-day or next-day multimedia products, when required, to support ongoing promotional activities, communication campaigns, senior leader engagement, and time-sensitive publication needs. 4. Post-production and formatting: Edit photographic and video content, including colour correction, audio enhancement, graphics integration, captioning, and formatting for multiple delivery platforms and communication requirements. 5. Corporate visual record and archive management: Organize, maintain, and preserve the corporate visual record of ACT activities, including B -roll, photographic packages, interviews, metadata, file structures, and archival products for future communication and retrieval needs. 6. Stakeholder coordination and communication alignment: Coordinate closely with the ACT/SEC Hub personnel to ensure all multimedia products support approved communication objectives. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C 7. Compliance and quality assurance: Ensure all multimedia products comply with NATO visual identity standards, branding guidance, security requirements, copyright regulations, and agreed quality standards before delivery for publication or distribution. 8. Equipment readiness and deployment support: Operate, maintain, and safeguard assigned multimedia production equipment, ensuring readiness for frequent deployment, travel, and on-site event support. 9. Innovation and continuous improvement: Monitor developments in multimedia production techniques, digital communications, and emerging technologies to improve content quality, production efficiency, and audience engagement. Essential Qualifications 1. A secondary education with completed advanced vocational training in photography, videography, multimedia production, communications, or a related field. 2. Minimum of 2 years demonstrated experience planning and executing photographic, video, and audio coverage in cooperation with cross-functional communication teams. 3. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in post-production, including photo and video editing, colour correction, audio enhancement, graphics integration, captioning, file formatting, and delivery for multiple platforms. 4. Proven ability to deliver same-day or next-day multimedia products under compressed timelines, including in dynamic environments with limited on-site support. 5. Demonstrated experience managing multimedia files and archives. 6. Demonstrated understanding of communication quality control, including visual identity, branding, copyright, security, release, and publication requirements. 7. Demonstrated ability to operate, maintain, safeguard, and deploy professional multimedia equipment in support of on-site and travel-related event coverage. Desirable Qualifications 1. Experience working in military organizations and/or with military audiences. 2. Experience working in multinational organizations. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C Annex B Requirements Matrix Contractor’s technical proposals will be assessed on the qualifications of both the company and individuals proposed to perform the work. Individuals’ résumés will be measured against each of the criteria specified below in order to ascertain whether the individuals have adequately qualifications to be considered compliant. (HQ SACT reserves the right to conduct technical discussions of nominated candidates). Examples of how detailed knowledge levels were attained are expected. Ultimately Contractor companies shall clearly demonstrate by providing unequivocal reference to where company/key personnel meet the criteria set forth in this solicitation (please include page number, reference to CV or links as applicable). Active NATO or National SECRET (or higher) security clearance Valid NATO Nation passport with no travel restrictions to NATO nations Proficiency in the use of the Microsoft Office Tool suite and Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Lightroom Minimum of 70 Points in the Subject Matter Expert Criteria All personnel citizen of NATO member nation (Nationality must be indicated to include other citizenships) NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C Subject Matter Expert Criteria (100 pts possible) Item Range Point values assigned based on level of knowledge/experience in relation to the tasks contained in the SOW – not solely on the number of years’ experience. Failure to provide exact reference (page, paragraph, line #, ref to CV) to where experience can be validated will result is disqualification. Page/ Paragraph/ Line Reference Score 100 Points 1. A secondary education in a relevant field and two years relevant experience OR 4-6 years relevant experience. No Degree (plus 2 years’ experience) and not 4-6 years relevant experience: Non- compliant 0 points Degree in relevant field plus 2 years’ experience or 4-6 years’ relevant experience: 1 - 5 points 2. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to deliver content creation and narrative structure by providing three (3) examples of their OWN video work. Examples located on Google drive and a link provided within the proposal response. No own work provided: Non- compliant 0 point Work provided: 1 - 70 Points 3. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in covering events. Less than 2 years: 0 Points 2+ years: 1 - 5 Points 4. Minimum of 2 years’ experience visual storytelling. Less than 2 years: 0 points 2+ years: 1 - 5 points 5. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in working independently and under compressed timelines in dynamic event environments with limited on-site support. Less than 2 years: 0 points 2+ years: 1 - 5 points 6. Minimum of 2 years’ working with cross-functional teams, including subject matter experts, promotion officers, and PR professionals. No experience: 0 points 2+ years: 1 - 5 points 7. Experience with managing and fostering relationships across all levels. No experience: 0 points Experience: 1 - 5 points
